{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The territories' economic stability and potential for growth must be considered in any trade agreements between the United States and other Pacific nations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The territories should be given flexibility or exemption from laws that increase costs for their populations, such as the minimum wage and the Jones Act concerning shipping.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"All unreasonable impediments to the territories' prosperity should be removed, including unreasonable U.S. customs practices.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Territories such as American Samoa should be able to properly develop their resources, including fishing, when jobs and the economy depend on it.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A commonwealth and territories advisory committee consisting of representatives from all five U.S. territories should be appointed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The commonwealth and territories advisory committee will be integrated into the president's transition team.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The commonwealth and territories advisory committee will perform a holistic review of all federal regulations affecting the territories and commonwealths.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A Special Assistant to the President responsible for day-to-day interaction with the territories and commonwealths should be appointed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Special Assistant to the President will be the direct connection for the Office of Insular Affairs, the citizens of the territories and commonwealths, and the White House.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Territory of Puerto Rico exists.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
